info.name: QuickBite — Core Service
info.description: Folders match the modules in core-service/src/app/*. Login first to capture role tokens — every authenticated request reads its token from the role-scoped collection variable.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login per role captures the accessToken to a role-scoped variable used by the rest of the collection.

request.description: Use this to register an EXTRA customer if you need one. The seed already inserted customer@quickbite.test, so duplicates will 409.
Reads refresh_token from cookies. Postman's cookie jar will carry it forward after login.

item.name: Internal (s2s) — uses api-key header
item.description: These mirror what order-service calls during placement. Useful for spot-checking the contracts.
